senses.gloss: f. (גבן, v. גְּבִין I) (the camel’s) hump. Pl. גְּבִינָתָה.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 5:3:2">Y. Sabb. V, 7ᵇ</cite> bot. (expl. <he>מטולטלת</he>) <he>כהדא כֵּיפָה דהיא משויא ג׳</he> like a ball (a cushion) to level the humps; cmp. <cite ref="C00100"><he>גְּבִיעָה</he> II</cite>.
